name: CSaw
author: Emilie Gillet
description: The emblematic Braids sawtooth, with a notch cut into the start of every cycle and a bendable ramp.

controls.label: Depth
controls.description: Deepens the notch cut into each sawtooth cycle.

controls.label: Width
controls.description: Moves the notch from the start of the cycle toward its end.

controls.label: Bend
controls.description: Bends the sawtooth ramp from concave through straight to convex.

controls.label: Tilt
controls.description: Tilts the notched segment, flattening the step at one extreme and doubling it at the other.

outputs.aux: The same waveform with the notch depth mirrored.

upstream: Braids AnalogOscillator::RenderCSaw with MacroOscillator::RenderCSaw's make-up stage
